I'm a Master's student in Business Analytics at Wake Forest University with a background in mathematics, statistics, and sports analytics. My interests include data analysis, predictive modeling, and using data to support decision-making in sports and business.
  
As a hockey player, rock climber, and lifelong sports fan, I am excited to combine my strong math skills with my passion for sports. As a current employee of the Tampa Bay Rays and through my past internships with the App State baseball team and Prep Baseball Report, I am strengthening and expanding my skills in data collection and analysis through real world experience.

Explore this website to learn more about me, my experience, and my data analytics projects.
